title: PCC Leader Detained in São Paulo After Capture in Bolivia
seoTitle: PCC Leader Arrested and Transferred to São Paulo
subtitle: Roberto Prieto Filho, known as "Betinho da Baixada," is in custody at Provisional Detention Center IV in Pinheiros
excerpt: Roberto Prieto Filho, an alleged PCC leader, was arrested in Bolivia and has been held in São Paulo since last Wednesday (23).
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Alleged to be one of the leaders of the criminal faction First Capital Command (PCC), Roberto Prieto Filho, known as "Betinho da Baixada," has been detained since last Wednesday (23) at a prison facility in São Paulo, where he remains at the disposal of the courts at Provisional Detention Center IV in the Pinheiros neighborhood.
